entry.title: Delivering Secure and Accessible Banking Support With Be My Eyes

media:group.media:title: Delivering Secure and Accessible Banking Support With Be My Eyes
media:group.media:description:
Financial services should be secure, convenient, and accessible for everyone. Yet for customers who are blind or have low vision, everyday banking tasks, from reading statements to navigating ATMs or mobile apps, can present hidden barriers.
Be My Eyes helps banks and financial institutions remove these challenges and deliver truly accessible, secure customer experiences. In this video, we showcase a real-world accessible banking use case, demonstrating how blind and low-vision customers can connect directly with customer service through the Be My Eyes Customer Accessibility Suite.
Discover how accessible support can enhance customer trust, improve service outcomes, and help banks meet accessibility expectations—without compromising on security.

media:group.media:title: Service AI vs Traditional Support
media:group.media:description:
What does customer support look like for a blind or low vision customer when accessibility is overlooked?
In this video, we demonstrate a customer support journey involving an AV receiver support query. First, we show the challenges a blind or low vision customer may face when trying to get help through traditional, inaccessible support channels. Then, we show how the same experience can be transformed with Service AI.
By combining AI-powered assistance with image understanding and conversational support, Service AI helps customers get answers faster and more independently, creating a smoother and more inclusive support experience.
Learn more here: https://www.bemyeyes.com/business/bme-service-ai/

media:group.media:title: What Accessible Hospitality Looks Like!
media:group.media:description:
Traveling should be accessible to everyone.
Our founder Hans Jørgen Wiberg recently visited a Hilton hotel to explore firsthand how their accessibility features are making a difference for blind and low-vision guests — from in-room accommodations to navigating common spaces with confidence.
Hilton is proud to be a Be My Eyes partner, and their commitment to inclusive hospitality is something we're excited to highlight.
Did you know? Hilton is also available on the Be My Eyes Service Directory, where blind and low-vision users can connect directly with trained Hilton support agents for real-time visual assistance — whenever they need it.
